messages:
audrey: FYI — customer JUST reported a compliance audit question: they want proof that BYOK HSM keys cannot be exfil'd by us. They asked for RBAC matrix, audit log sample, and KMS integration diagram. Anyone have a quick checklist we can send? 
lee: short answer: need separation of duties + attested HSM import ops. I'll pull the RBAC matrix. 
josh: @maria can you attach the recent audit log redacted sample? we should show key import events, operator IDs, and HSM signature blocks. 
maria: attaching sanitized snippet in a sec. here's an example log line: `2026-03-10T21:03:12Z IMPORT_START key_id=ck-12345 operator=ops:user_lee hsm_slot=slot-a` 
maria: also include `IMPORT_COMPLETE` + `ATTESTATION_CERT` entries. 
audrey: compliance specifically asked about our ability to rotate customer CMKs without customer approval. we should be explicit. 
lee: note: for BYOK we never hold the plaintext; rotation happens only if customer triggers or if escrow flow used. add the escrow playbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/byok-escrow> 
josh: vuln triage note — last week's CVE-2025-xxxx on vendor-hsm firmware: confirm whether our deployed HSM images are affected. @sec-ops-bot please verify firmware versions across regions. 
sec-ops-bot: scanning hosts for hsm-proxy firmware... results queued, ETA 90s. 
audrey: can we put together a one-page for compliance: 1) RBAC matrix 2) sample audit log 3) KMS integration diagram 4) rotation policy 5) incident playbook/exposure statement? 
maria: I'll draft the log sample + redaction checklist. 
lee: I'll export RBAC table and put in google doc. 
josh: I'll run a smoke query to ensure tokenization & caching not leaking key material; will post results. 
audrey: thanks. action items: (1) doc draft, (2) firmware check, (3) confirm escrow constraints. I'll create ENGSEC ticket and cc compliance. 
sec-ops-bot: created ticket ENGSEC-1987 — "BYOK: compliance packet & firmware triage" assigned to audrey,lee,maria. 
audrey: pinging oncall for a quick sync in 15 to align wording before we send to customer. :phone: 
lee: oncall (josh) — can you join? 
josh: on it. joining in 10.
